fields.name: work area
fields.meaning: Scratch memory the game uses while running (map, units, menus). Rebuilt while playing; not a save file, but every save file is copied from tables here.
fields.evidence: written at power-on with no input and during play; the save routine copies from here

fields.name: magic
fields.meaning: Save file marker, the letters "GV". While a file is being written it holds "ST" and becomes "GV" only after the check value is stored, so a half-written file is ignored. Without it the slot shows NO DATA.
fields.evidence: save code writes 0x5453 first and 0x5647 last; loader and file list compare 0x5647; boot reads the marker of all three slots

fields.name: stage
fields.meaning: Current stage number; the load list prints the stage name from it (1 = STAGE01 Side 7).
fields.evidence: copied from work variable 0x1AE4 on save, restored on load; set to 1 at new game; save with 1 lists STAGE01 サイド7

fields.name: turn / file kind
fields.meaning: Battle turn at the moment of saving (1-99). 0 means the file was saved between stages; such a file uses the short layout (two 0x800-byte copies) instead of the battle layout below.
fields.evidence: copied from work 0x1B14; battle code counts it up to 99; save/load pick the layout from it; saves with 1, 2 and 3 list 1, 2 and 3 ターン

fields.name: owned unit count
fields.meaning: Number of entries used in the owned-unit table at 0x5B9C.
fields.evidence: copied from work 0x0F28; game hands out one 8-byte entry per increment; 5 in saves with 5 units

fields.name: supply points
fields.meaning: Supply points (money); shown on the load list. Capped at 999,999.
fields.evidence: copied from work 0x1AEA; shop adds/subtracts prices and caps at 999999; file list prints it after 補給ポイント

fields.name: stage bonus B
fields.meaning: Second per-stage supply bonus, folded into the supply income at the end of a stage and cleared when a stage starts. Always 0 in saves seen.
fields.evidence: copied from work 0x04BC; results screen adds it to stage income; cleared at stage setup

fields.name: character count
fields.meaning: Number of entries used in the character list at 0x5D9E.
fields.evidence: game adds/removes entries; 4 with 4 pilots

fields.name: item stocks
fields.meaning: Owned counts of 44 item types. Buying adds one (max about 9), selling removes one. All 0 in saves seen.
fields.evidence: shop code raises/lowers these per item id

fields.name: progress flags
fields.meaning: Probably story/event flags (768 bits); one bit flipped after a story kill. One bit feeds the file summary.
fields.evidence: byte copy of work memory; changed between battle saves

fields.name: group count
fields.meaning: Number of groups used at 0x5F1E (0-4).
fields.evidence: game adds (max 4) and removes; 1 with 1 group

fields.name: map view X
fields.meaning: Left edge of the visible part of the battle map.
fields.evidence: copied from map scroll memory; 3 to 4 across saves

fields.name: map view Y
fields.meaning: Top edge of the visible part of the battle map.
fields.evidence: copied from map scroll memory; 0 to 8 across saves

fields.name: cursor X
fields.meaning: Map cursor column.
fields.evidence: copied from cursor memory; 7 to 11 across saves

fields.name: cursor Y
fields.meaning: Map cursor row.
fields.evidence: copied from cursor memory; 1 to 15 across saves

fields.name: list C count
fields.meaning: Number of entries used in the list at 0x5FD4 (max 15).
fields.evidence: game adds/removes; 0 while empty

fields.name: list C
fields.meaning: Up to 15 one-byte ids; buying a pilot removes one. Empty in all saves. Possibly the shop pilot roster.
fields.evidence: add/remove code; shop purchase removes

fields.name: stage earnings
fields.meaning: Per-stage supply earnings, added to supply points at the end of a stage. Computed at map setup in versus-style play; always 0 in story play.
fields.evidence: results screens add it to supply; stage setup clears/computes it

fields.name: force average level
fields.meaning: Ceiling of the average level of deployed units. Used to set the level of new and extra units.
fields.evidence: computed by averaging deployed levels (rounded up); level math adds it; 1 with all level 1

fields.name: cleared-game mark
fields.meaning: Set when the game has been cleared and a new game started from cleared data; the load list shows an extra mark.
fields.evidence: set on the cleared-game menu path; file list prints an extra string when nonzero; 0 observed

fields.name: scenario mode
fields.meaning: Mode byte: 0 story, 1 link battle, 2 forced for a special stage; when nonzero the load list shows a fixed title instead of the stage name.
fields.evidence: set on the link path; forced to 2 for stage 0x1B on load; 0 observed

fields.name: entry name
fields.meaning: Name-entry buffer (16 characters), default "##" when no name was entered.
fields.evidence: starts as "##"; name-entry screen reads/writes it

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Not written; zero (the file is cleared before writing).
fields.evidence: file cleared before writing; zero in all saves

fields.name: check value
fields.meaning: CRC-16 (reflected, start 0xFFFF, result inverted: CRC-16/X-25) over the 0xFFC bytes 0x5002-0x5FFD (the marker is not included). Bad value = NO DATA.
fields.evidence: recomputed and matched on every valid save file (turns 1, 2, 3, all three slots); boot re-reads exactly this range

fields.name: file 2
fields.meaning: Second save file, same layout as 0x5000-0x5FFF.
fields.evidence: file select loops over the three slots; filled by saving to slot 2

fields.name: file 3
fields.meaning: Third save file, same layout.
fields.evidence: file select loops over the three slots; filled by saving to slot 3

fields.name: not used
fields.meaning: The game does not save to the console's internal memory.
fields.evidence: identical before and after saving

value.value: between-stages short layout (two 0x800 copies); full decode not implemented
